character_count_method: Sum exact narration_text strings per scene; spaces, punctuation and embedded LF included. No headings/screen instructions, no separators between requests. UTF-16 count; present strings contain no surrogate pairs.
actual_credit_ceiling_formula: 8903 * confirmed Jun voice multiplier; do not execute if multiplier is unknown or above approved scope
cash_policy: Existing included credits only, sufficient for approved ceiling. No top-up, usage-based billing, upgrade, renewal or automatic rollover to paid spend. Insufficient balance or custom-rate multiplier needs director budget revision.

reference_subscription_allocation.note: Illustrative prorated subscription allocation, NOT marginal invoice or verified user plan; excludes taxes and promotions.

media_scope: Native charts/editorial cards, local rendering and owned previous assets whose reuse rights are confirmed. Maps need original source/provider and reuse terms checked; paid maps, stock, AI images/video, music and ASR excluded.
approval_scope: script-v2, existing Jun/eleven_v4, one full take plus at most 1484 correction characters, base 8903 credits subject to confirmed multiplier and sufficient included balance, zero additional cash. Script approval is not paid-generation approval.
uncertainties: Subscription, remaining balance, commercial licence unverified
Pronunciation expansion/audio tags can increase exact request characters: recount before execution
20% correction budget may not cover entire-scene retries; enforce actual cumulative request characters
